issue.title: Should svelte-announcer be a custom element?
issue.body:
### Describe the problem

Hi, I was trying out sveltekit and was surprised to see inline styles in the svelte announcer div. These styles kind of pollute the DOM and seems like could cause issues too (e.g. #971).

This is pretty much a perfect use case for shadow DOM - progressively enhanced element with isolated styles, while still allowing light DOM to dictate the content using a slot. In the future, this could also be exposed to the user if they want to customize it. For example, I found it odd that it only announces the title, instead of "Navigated to {title}" (which I see in #971 btw). So as a user, I could customize the text myself.

### Describe the proposed solution

A `<svelte-announcer>` custom element that hides all the logic and styles, while still allowing full control over content.

### Alternatives considered

_No response_

### Importance

nice to have

### Additional Information

_No response_
